summary:
Review a complete finite delegated sequence once against exact source, input identities, outputs, resource limits, ordered actions and original absolute deadlines. Let its owner advance through the reviewed gates without success-by-success approval. First failure, uncertainty, drift or exhaustion stops it; preserve original results and perform only selected cleanup. Independent step clocks stay inside their parent scope. No automatic retry, renewed allowance or success relabeling follows. Atlas grants no operation.

Conditionally produced inputs may feed later steps only through closed reviewed derivations. Verify the actual identity, remaining capacity and original deadline before the dependent action. Ordinary isolated development verification and bounded read-only Home metadata diagnostics already have standing authorization; actual configuration changes keep their reviewed boundary. A repaired diagnostic before any operational original does not silently become another native run.

Isolation covers engine storage, runtime state, outputs, namespaces and process containment, beyond operation names. ADR0096 permits genuinely fresh work demonstrably independent of retained historical Unknowns. Preserve original births, missing facts and failures; relevant unresolved interference still blocks its operation. A named hold keeps its own scope, while unrelated unavailable history is no global stop. Use existing custody rather than another recovery ledger.

Typed observations distinguish running, paused, stopped and reported-but-unverifiable actors. Preserve original outcome separately from cleared current metadata. Stop-RPC success, service/finalizer outcome, process absence and original-birth settlement are different facts. A not-found/unconfigured service need not expose a configured guard-only command property. Batched stop must not skip remaining owned units because another scope was already collected. Constructor fixtures and callback tuples cannot establish whole retirement.

Freeze the complete actual loader/runtime/source closure before the operational clock. Put absolute start gates before queued payload/source reads; repeated short I/O limits cannot renew an original. A consumed or uncertain send is never resent. Retain partial stdout/stderr/backing within receipt caps and preserve the first error when cleanup also fails. Missing partial-start births remain Unknown rather than synthetic success records.

Establish cleanup ownership immediately after successful process creation, before closes, birth capture, persistence or gate release can fail. An actual direct unreaped child is a kernel-owned identity even when startTicks capture failed; do not invent that observation. Separate-session descendants are not settled by parent-group death. Preserve missing custody Unknown and stop dependent work. Capture the actual carrier entry and independently prove its death after return; inner-observer death is not carrier death. Freeze consumed proposals or reconstruct/check exact arguments and reviewed environment.

Wait deadlines must preserve cleanup, collection and independent outside-proof reserves inside the unchanged original. The accepted recovery parent used wait165/cleanup170/collection175/cold180; its metadata carrier used wait890/cleanup-collection895/own-cold900. These are qualified source cuts, not a generic grant. Causal controls exercised actual gated-child birth-observation failure and a sleeping-child timeout; late cleanup refused before signalling. Actual runtime receipts were still required separately.

Root accepted the actual complete recovery→metadata sequence at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6407605875. A fresh180 reconciled authentic old records, twelve captured births/groups, current journal population and outside archive before durable one-shot admission and exact reverse nonlazy retirement. Outside Root/custodian/observer/controller proofs completed inside180. Historical473d remained FAILED/Unknown with expired900 and missing old post-mount facts unchanged; only its owned held journal retired. Then a distinct900/600 metadata original completed actual signed lookup and whole retirement, including the carrier separately from its observer. No intermediate success approval occurred. Neither payload export, reusable image nor first consumer was qualified.

Earlier source envelopes completed with one apply and independent cold in about150 and42seconds. Earlier initialization and empty-journal lifecycles established only their scoped cleanup; failures remain retained. Home reproduced a procfs short read: drain to EOF within cumulative cap and unchanged phase checks, and persist raw observations before validation. New fields cannot reconstruct older kernel state. Archive bytes remain distinct from actor retirement. A short pickup expired UNUSED with no original; fresh selection renewed nothing. Reporting checkpoints renew nothing. The genuine provider fixture failed54/58 on missing inert helpers; same-owner changed-source repair and fresh CI remained separate from unchanged replay or native acceptance. Previous versions retain detailed examples and public source pointers.

Endpoint-specific preflight avoids wrong credential assumptions. Home existing OAuth/keyring supplied private Checks unavailable to Root credential; neither a new token/App nor Root UI was needed. Policy403 is unavailable, never empty policy. Refresh actual workflows, trigger filters, source/CI identities and runtime before dependent work. Actual tested checkout/tree or canonical source projection matters; head_sha alone does not prove tested bytes.

SOURCE publication accepted at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6408699360 used one ready/one canonical apply, exact seven-file/tree/parent readback and independent cold inside900; outside command completion118.396seconds. No provider/native/bake or token-savings claim follows. Prior54/58 and prewrite failures remain. Parse/hash FINAL generated bytes; an earlier compile claim missed a later syntax change. Recheck actual refs after other preflight RPCs immediately before write markers, without claiming atomic main CAS. Verify same boot and deadline after final fsync/output. Container-exec children escape host scope; actual HOST OAuth supported direct gh, removing that custody gap without new token/App. Actual hourly sync completed before launch, next timer exceeded the horizon and relevant manual writers were held; no host/timer change.

Integrated source controls subsequently caught caller-wait and custody-socket behavior that smaller tuple/constructor controls missed. The selected source ends pending custody before its existing lease, preserving explicit worker-stop, actual-wait, independent outside-proof and collection cuts. EOF while a caller remains alive must avoid busy spinning without treating EOF as parent death. These causal source repairs were accepted with exact tested-source joins at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6409199892; they did not qualify payload copy or reconstruct older native state.

Reuse unchanged qualified file bytes while joining the actual changed files, current tested tree and artifact custody. This reduces unnecessary evidence reconstruction without turning artifact bytes into writer or namespace retirement. Closed file populations, actual writer births/groups, carrier settlement and original-deadline checks remain different determining facts. At the later source checkpoint https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6409947952 the production Root action and complete reference/all-writer gates still did not exist. Record a source checkpoint as source-or-precise-gap, never a native finish estimate; continue genuinely disjoint qualification preparation rather than infer readiness or request repeated success approvals.
title: Finite delegated execution requires demonstrated isolation
